name: harden-plugin-storage-299
title: 加固插件 SQLite 与 Secret #299
description: 实现 fail-closed 鉴权、数据库边界、危险 SQL 限制、资源配额与生命周期清理。
creator: TalexDreamSoul
notes: Implementation and final security review complete. Core focused 140 tests, Utils focused 18 tests, touch-translation 3 tests, node/web typecheck, scoped lint, plugin validation, production build, built-worker integration and diff-check pass. Covers authoritative fail-closed guards, dual SQL policy, real timeout termination/recovery, row/result/disk/native heap bounds, pre/post-open symlink checks, lifecycle teardown, atomic Secret storage and target-only uninstall purge. The resolver no longer creates data directories; libSQL path-only open is bracketed by immediate post-open and per-operation canonical checks. A same-OS-user syscall-level directory race cannot be made atomic without dirfd/openat support and remains part of #297 process/filesystem isolation, but no plugin SQL runs before post-open validation. No commit/push or GitHub close performed.
